زَائِجَةٌ A four-sided, or round, scheme, made to exhibit the horoscope, or places [or configurations] of the stars at the time of a birth: an astrological
term [arabicized from the Pers. زَايْچَهْ]: so in the “ Shifá el-Ghaleel, ” from the “ Mefáteeh el- 'Uloom, ” by Er-Rázee. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
